assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original premium photobooth frame BACKGROUND MATERIAL, portrait 2:3, flat frontal view edge-to-edge. Sweeping gathered curtains occupy the upper 13% and outer 5% each side; the large central area from 15% to 87% should be quiet deep-red velvet with restrained vertically draped folds, so four photos will later cover it. A low velvet stage floor and warm narrow gold footlights occupy bottom 12%. No sign, no lettering, no marquee rectangles, no photo boxes, no photos, no people. Real dimensional material and deep shadows, confident cinematic richness, sophisticated illustrated-realistic craft, no generic clip art. The entire image is a usable flat graphic background, not a mockup on a desk and no outer white margin. Original design.
